title: Meeting Merger (Intervals)
hints: Sort the intervals by start. After that, an interval can only overlap the one you are currently building.
std::pair already compares by first, then second - std::sort needs no comparator here.
Walk the sorted list: if the next start <= current end, extend the current end with max(); otherwise push a new interval.
Use max when extending: {1,10} followed by {2,3} must stay {1,10}.
